description: What is this business legally, and is it in good standing? Returns the legal profile for an entity_id: legal name, organization type, SOS file number, charter date, SOS status, right to transact business (forfeited means franchise tax forfeiture), mailing address, and counts of locations, TABC licenses and affiliates. Also returns state_permits (Comptroller fuels, IFTA, interstate trucker, tobacco, hotel occupancy tax and direct-pay permits, flagging suspended permits and hotel locations gone out of business) and tabc_credit_law_delinquency (appearances on TABC's Credit Law Delinquent List: a wholesaler reported unpaid alcohol deliveries, so the retailer may buy for cash only while listed), federal_exclusions (active SAM.gov debarments and suspensions, shown only where the excluded firm has this entity's exact name and street address; an empty list is not a clearance), motor_carriers (FMCSA USDOT numbers with the same name and street address, each flagging an out-of-service order in force; get_motor_carriers has the full record), and labor_summary (five-year OSHA and wage-and-hour totals for records with the same name and street address; get_labor_record has the records). Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. Example: {"entity_id": "32057926266"}.

entity_id.description: entity_id from resolve_business (11-digit Texas taxpayer number), or a 10-digit SOS file number.
